Class_Skill_Desc_Chaos Drive: Deals lightning damage with a potency of 300 to all enemies in a straight line.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Drain Touch Potency: 400</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts target with Paralysis when under the effect of Drain Touch</br>Duration: 18s</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom</br>Duration: 10s</br>Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.</br>Shares a recast timer with Deep Freeze and Hell Wind.
Class_Skill_Desc_Deep Freeze: Deals ice damage with a potency of 300 to all enemies in a straight line.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to ice.</br>Drain Touch Potency: 400</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to ice.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.</br>Additional Effect: Freezes time for target when under the effect of Drain Touch</br>Duration: 4s</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom</br>Duration: 10s</br>Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.</br>Shares a recast timer with Hell Wind and Chaos Drive.
Class_Skill_Desc_Doomsday: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 350 to all enemies in a straight line.</br>Drain Touch Potency: 500</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.</br>Additional Effect: Removes one beneficial status from target, with some exceptions when under the effect of Drain Touch</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom</br>Duration: 10s</br>Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.
Class_Skill_Desc_Drain Touch: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 150.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Absorbs a portion of damage dealt as HP</br>Additional Effect: Grants Drain Touch</br>Drain Touch Effect: Most attacks cannot reduce your HP to less than 1, and increases the potency of Phantom Necromancer actions</br>Duration: 6s
Class_Skill_Desc_Hell Wind: Deals wind damage with a potency of 300 to all enemies in a straight line.</br>Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to wind.</br>Drain Touch Potency: 400</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to wind.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.</br>Additional Effect: 10% chance to Petrify target when under the effect of Drain Touch</br>Petrify Effect: Incapacitated upon taking damage</br>Duration: 10s</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom</br>Duration: 10s</br>Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.</br>Shares a recast timer with Deep Freeze and Chaos Drive.
